Anthropic Ships MCP 2.0

Anthropic today released version 2.0 of the Model Context Protocol, adding streaming tool results and a formal capability negotiation handshake.

The update is backward compatible with 1.x servers, and early adopters report a meaningful reduction in round-trips for multi-tool workflows.

Independent benchmarks are not yet available, and the team cautioned that real-world overhead depends heavily on transport choice.
